title: Power Rankings: Miami nice, but NBA title is anyone's game
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Preseason
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Like we said, this is where defending champs always start. Not that my Heat really care. They could go 41-41 and what, really, could the committee say to hurt them?

rankings.summaryHtml: Not since Detroit in 1989 has the losing team in the NBA Finals recovered from the disappointment to win it all the following June. But I'm guessing Mavs don't know that.

rankings.summaryHtml: I'm sure they'll be as good as ever, but I can't subscribe to the ''Spurs always win in odd years'' theory. I know about '99, '03 and '05, but how do you explain 2001?
